He estimated time-varying parameters of a policy reaction rule for the funds rate consistent with observed long-term rates. Agents are assumed to use the current parameter values of the policy rule to forecast future short rates.15 Fuhrer argued that the parameters he obtained are consistent with general views on the evolution of the Fed’s reaction function.
